review_type: Independent adversarial source and event-driven review of deferred parameter file selection
verdict: REJECTED for exact-clone parity. Deferred Load and Compare now reach explicit file selection instead of the mobile last-file fallback or no-op. Two pointer-driven parameter tests independently pass. Selection completion stages edits or comparison rows without sending parameter commands. This does not implement the reference's complete parsing, excluded-parameter, offline editing, missing-name feedback, native file-provider or five-platform workflows. A workspace log inspected during review also contains a failing swarm cancellation regression and cannot support an all-green claim at that snapshot.

scores.scale: Provisional qualitative exact-reference-parity judgment, not completion percentages. Narrow selected-file tests do not justify a whole-product score increase. No native mobile app, full reference GUI or physical vehicle was qualified by this review.

independent_validation.scope: Reviewer executed current actual egui pointer-event tests for a.param selection versus z.param, known changed-value staging, Compare preserving staged edits, cancellation, invalid UTF-8 read errors and different-system cancellation. Tests invoke the production file_ui completion helper; they do not click the full connected parameter screen's Load/Compare launch buttons or validate an Android/iOS document provider.

independent_validation.result: Inspected log shows FAILED: swarm::sequence_tests::cancelling_background_selection_keeps_the_existing_image; 108 passed, 1 failed, 1 ignored
independent_validation.scope: This was a parent-produced workspace log read by the reviewer, not an independently executed full-workspace command. The failed assertion is editor.file_picker.is_none() after first-frame Escape. Top-modal Escape semantics and this cold-frame test need reconciliation before claiming a passing workspace gate.

verified_improvements: Load from file and Compare Params now create a deferred FilePicker request and capture the selected system/component identity.
ParamEditor::ui polls file_ui with current parameter values and identity; a changed identity clears the pending request and reports an error.
File cancellation clears the pending selection without replacing staged edits or comparison rows.
Read failure includes the selected path in a toast and preserves the previous editable state.
The completion helper has no Link argument and sends no vehicle commands. Actual Write Params remains a separate action.
Compare builds a separate diff list and does not immediately replace existing staged edits.

findings.status: verified source mismatch at review snapshot; parent informed
evidence: Utilities/ParamFile.cs loadParamFile filters SYSID_SW_MREV, WP_TOTAL, CMD_TOTAL, FENCE_TOTAL, SYS_NUM_RESETS, ARSPD_OFFSET, GND_ABS_PRESS, GND_TEMP, BARO1_GND_PRESS, BARO2_GND_PRESS, BARO3_GND_PRESS, BARO_GND_TEMP, CMD_INDEX, LOG_LASTFILE and FORMAT_VERSION.
ConfigRawParams.loadparamsfromfile repeats a subset of that protection before assigning grid values.
Rust paramfile::load accepts these names, and file_ui stages every known changed loaded value or includes it in comparison rows. Both paths call the same permissive parser.
findings.impact: An imported file can stage reset, count and calibration-related fields that the reference deliberately excludes. The current selected-file tests contain none of these source-derived exclusions.
findings.required_fix: Implement the full source-derived excluded-name set centrally for parameter-file import so Load and Compare agree, and add regression fixtures containing every excluded name beside a normal changed parameter.

evidence: Reference ParamFile.loadParamFile parses numbers with invariant culture and throws FormatException identifying a parameter and token on invalid numeric input.
Rust paramfile::load silently omits tokens that fail f32 parsing. file_ui cannot distinguish a malformed file from a successfully parsed partial or empty file.
Reference StreamReader detects text BOMs; std::fs::read_to_string accepts UTF-8 only. The current bad.txt test demonstrates an error path, not source encoding equivalence.
findings.impact: A malformed parameter file can be partially staged with no explanation, whereas the reference parser rejects the invalid numeric token. Supported text encodings also differ.
findings.required_fix: Add a fallible source-compatible import parser and decode supported reference encodings. Parse the complete file before mutating edits or comparison state; surface precise format errors.

evidence: ConfigRawParams.BUT_load_Click passes offline=true when the stream is closed; loadparamsfromfile then adds previously unknown names to the offline parameter collection and calls Activate.
For live loads, the reference counts missing names and shows a No matching Params dialog with the missing list.
Rust ParamEditor::ui returns before rendering file actions when app.link is None, and file_ui silently discards unknown names.
findings.required_fix: Implement offline parameter file editing as a real state workflow, plus source-compatible missing-name feedback for live files. Do not describe known-name staging tests as complete parameter-workflow parity.

evidence: run-38-workspace-tests.log records the existing swarm background cancellation test failing because its picker remains pending.
The test sends Escape on the first modal frame; the new FilePicker gates Escape on top-modal status. The platform picker test was warmed before Escape, but the swarm workflow test was not.
findings.required_fix: Verify intended cold/open-frame and visible top-modal Escape behavior, reconcile the test with that behavior without weakening cancellation guarantees, then rerun the affected swarm path and workspace suite.

findings.subsystem: Native file access and complete platform/UI delivery
evidence: Mobile selection still browses app-local directories; no Android Storage Access Framework or iOS document-provider path is implemented or exercised here.
Other platform::open_text mobile callers still return None, including mission/polygon/KML and connection-list workflows.
No native mobile build/install/run, parameter screen screenshot comparison, real parameter round-trip or actual vehicle validation was performed by this reviewer.
The prior intermittent simulator startup timeout remains unproven fixed; later passing tests alone do not establish its cause or repair.
findings.required_fix: Continue the broader deferred text-import migration, implement native document access and actual platform delivery, and retain the reliability issue until cause and repair are established.

next_concrete_task: Fix the parameter-file exclusion and format-error mismatches and the observed swarm cancellation validation regression. Then migrate remaining text-import workflows and implement native mobile document access; offline parameter editing remains a separate exact-reference requirement.
not_verified: No full reference or Rust parameter UI was visually compared.
No Android or iOS native chooser, app installation or runtime was exercised.
No physical controller received parameters through this workflow.
The same-system/component disconnect-and-reconnect identity case was not tested; the current guard records only those numeric IDs.
The reviewer did not execute the full workspace suite independently; the observed failure is from the parent log.
